title: Duck-trigger wiring has no test: pending_any_plays and its flush call-site ordering are unpinned
detail: The duck trigger's pure predicate and its placement before the pending reset are untested. Moving the trigger after `a.pending = {}` or dropping a family from the OR-list kills ducking silently — all 17 tests stay green. The predicate is pure and headless-testable.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test driving pending_any_plays over each family (each >0 → true; zeroed Pending → false) in audio_test.odin, beside the existing envelope tests.

title: No test executes the device-gated halves: audio_init's no-device path, load_bed branches, boot fade-in seeding, destroy stop/unload
detail: Headless survival (hard rule 2) rests on the early-return ordering plus test_bed_off_is_silent_noop's zero-Audio no-op; no test runs audio_init against a missing device. Matches the #81 precedent and the no-raylib test discipline, so risk is structural only.
recommended_fix: Accept per discipline, or add a CI smoke step that runs the app binary briefly with no audio device and asserts exit 0 (the stderr 'no bed' note visible).

title: PR body test-count breakdown is wrong: actual split is 10 pre-existing + 7 new bed tests, not 13 + 4
evidence: - `odin test app/audio` → 17/17 (13 pre-existing + 4 new bed tests). — but audio_test.odin has 17 @(test) procs total, 10 through "test_consumer_spawn_draw :: proc(t: ^testing.T) {" and 7 new: "test_bed_envelope_shape", "test_bed_duck_retrigger", "test_bed_off_is_silent_noop", "test_bed_duck_never_raises", "test_bed_paused_ducked_level", "test_bed_retrigger_while_deep", "test_bed_mute_mirror_flag"
detail: The 17/17 total verifies (17 @(test) markers counted); the 13+4 breakdown is stale from an earlier review-fold state. Reviewers trusting the body miscount the new bed coverage by three tests.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR body line to '17/17 (10 pre-existing + 7 new bed tests)'.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
evidence: GATES array includes "Golden harness (T1 hashes + T2 software pixels + replay gate)|tools/harness.sh run" and "odin test app/audio -out:bin/audio-test"; git diff 339e173..HEAD --stat -- harness/ goldens/ demos/ core/ → empty (zero golden moves); 48 demos/*.dem counted; 17 @(test) in app/audio/audio_test.odin; shasum -a 256 assets/audio/ambience_loop.ogg → "7fdb30925eba3f8490895742a69ffebba16643d2ebd4f5dfe5cf88329a06d609" (913706 bytes, matches README + PR body)
detail: P0 100% (goldens byte-identical, consumer untouched, harness never inits audio — verified in code). P1 ~95% (envelope/pause/mute/levels/asset fully tested; only device-gated init halves partial, precedent-matching). Overall ~90% — above the 80% floor. Round-focus (a)-(d) all verified.
